# Swagat Group of Institutions (Swagat Odisha)

> A group of educational institutions in western Odisha, India, offering regular and distance courses with support from admission to course completion.

## Contact
- Phone: +91 78559 59544
- Email: contact@swagatodisha.com
- Website: https://www.swagatodisha.com/
- Main campus: Sargiguda, PO - Sargul, PS - Kantabanji, Dist - Balangir, Odisha 767039 (map: https://www.google.com/maps/search/?api=1&query=20.4094937,82.9106225)

## Campuses
- Sargiguda (Main Campus): Sargiguda, PO - Sargul, PS - Kantabanji, Balangir, Odisha 767039

## Common questions
- Where is Swagat Group of Institutions? The main campus is at Sargiguda near Kantabanji in Balangir district, Odisha. Other campuses are in Kantabanji, Bangomunda, Titilagarh, Sinapali, Ghantiguda and Bhawanipatna.
- Does Swagat offer distance education? Yes, both regular and distance courses.
- How do I apply or ask about admission? Call +91 78559 59544, email contact@swagatodisha.com, or register on the website.
